messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 429/503 error rate detected on hosted-api (us-west-2). Rolling spike starting ~2026-03-15T12:02Z. Paging @anna_oncall and oncall rotation. Link: https://dash.redwood/internal/429-503-live

anna_oncall: Oncall here — looking. Spike visible on /dash/429-503-live. 429s dominate (4:1), but 503s present on model-router pool. Top noisy tenants: tenant-t42, tenant-alpha, tenant-kappa. 95th latency normal => likely throttling/backpressure, not CPU.

jamie_sre: Quick checklist: 1) soft-rate-limit noisy tenants, 2) disable non-critical streaming/callouts, 3) enable fallback to cached small-model for heavy requests, 4) bounce model-router if we see connection floods. Prefer tenant shaping first.

anna_oncall: Agreed. I'm going to apply a temporary leaky-bucket on tenant-t42 and lower streaming concurrency on free-tier. Will also increase KV cache TTL for common prompts.

anna_oncall: Running:
```
rcctl traffic control apply --tenant tenant-t42 --policy leaky_bucket --rate 10r/s --burst 30
rcctl feature toggle --tier free --feature streaming --state off --reason "mitigation"
```

infra-bot: Executing command: `rcctl traffic control apply --tenant tenant-t42 --policy leaky_bucket --rate 10r/s --burst 30` — SUCCESS
infra-bot: Executing command: `rcctl feature toggle --tier free --feature streaming --state off --reason "mitigation"` — SUCCESS

lucy_support: Support note: notifying customers with >=10% error rate. Drafting batch message for tenant-t42 and tenant-alpha. Opening incident ticket INC-9876.

manu_product: FYI — disabling streaming will affect a few integrations but reduces persistent connections. Good to proceed.

anna_oncall: Metrics update (obs at 12:12Z): 429 rate down ~52% for tenant-t42, global 429s down ~28%, 503s stable. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/429-503-live?filters=mitigation

jamie_sre: Can we also temporarily reduce max-request-size for free-tier to cut down huge payloads? That might reduce model-router pressure.

ravi_engineer: I can push a gate: `max_request_tokens <= 4096` for free-tier. Will roll in 2 min.

infra-bot: Applying gate: `rbac apply --scope tier:free --gate max_tokens --value 4096` — SUCCESS

anna_oncall: Observed tail: a few tenants keep spiky retry patterns. Started a 30s retry-window backoff in edge-proxy for suspect IP ranges.

infra-bot: edge-proxy: updated retry-window config for IP ranges matching tenant-t42 patterns — deployed to us-west-2.

lucy_support: Customer comms sent for tenant-t42. They're seeing degraded streaming but can still poll for responses. Logged contact with account owner.

jamie_sre: Handoff note: I'm taking escalation at 12:30Z to monitor for 30m and coordinate if we need model-router bounce or failover to Dedicated. @anna_oncall you can handoff now.

anna_oncall: Handoff to @jamie_sre — leaving notes above. If 503s increase >10% from baseline, escalate to model-router bounce.

jamie_sre: 12:45Z metrics: 429s holding ~45% below peak, 503s unchanged. Identified two additional tenants with high request size; marking them for soft shaping.

jamie_sre: Applying soft shaping to tenant-alpha and tenant-kappa: `traffic control apply --tenant tenant-alpha --rate 5r/s --burst 20` and same for tenant-kappa.

infra-bot: Commands executed — SUCCESS.

manu_product: Quick decision: leave streaming disabled for free-tier for the remainder of the day, will re-evaluate postmortem.

anna_oncall: Agreed. Adding runbook item: add tenant-size wake-up checks and earlier heap/conn limits to detect floods.

jamie_sre: Final update at 13:02Z: global error rate back to near-normal, we've removed the most aggressive limits for low-impact tenants but left throttles on the persistent noisy ones. Closing live mitigation. Follow-up: postmortem and customer RCA. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident 1876 — mitigation complete. Created follow-up task: POSTMORTEM-1876, assigned to @jamie_sre and @manu_product.

anna_oncall: Logged handoff and notes in incident ticket INC-9876. Moving thread to postmortem channel if needed.
